normalized.result: Yes, that's the right behavior. Since I'm typing live, I'm constantly mid-thought — "grid and" is just a half-finished search on the way to something more. Rather than blanking my results or throwing an error while I'm still typing, it kept the sensible "grid" result showing and quietly hinted that the command wasn't finished yet. Then once I trimmed it back to just `grid`, the hint went away and search carried on as normal. That's exactly the gentle, forgiving handling I'd want — guide me without punishing me for typing one word at a time. Good.
